ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region centered at the peduncle junction extending into the mid-lobes; high-density high-intensity mottling and focal spotting concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edges; scattered white punctate spots present within the central dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an approximate angle of 115 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 10-12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration map across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced at the distal lobe extremities; continuous sequence of small 'valleys' and 'peaks' isolated from the water-surface background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge trajectory curving towards sharp distal tips; trailing edge lobes exhibit a slight concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white high-contrast pixel groups, ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in diameter, primarily located on the distal third of the right lobe and along the trailing edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) visible against the dark pigmentation of the lower right and central left lobes; parallel groupings of 3-4 lines are detectable on the lower right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregularity and jagged serration of the trailing edge suggestive of prior mechanical wear or trauma; a distinct reddish-brown pixel cluster is visible on the extreme left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'freckling' pattern consisting of isolated white pixels within the central dark regions, combined with dense 'salt-and-pepper' mottling at the lobe tips.
